shortBio: Computer Science student at Warsaw University of Technology, passionate about building elegant and functional digital solutions.
fullBio:
I am a Computer Science and Information Systems student at the Faculty of Mathematics and Information Technology of Warsaw University of Technology.

Driven by curiosity and a passion for problem-solving, I explore the intersection of mathematics and software development. I believe in building solutions that are not only technically sound but also user-centered and visually refined.

Currently focusing on full-stack development, algorithms, and system design.
